name: search_files
description: Read-only search in an allow-listed local repository. Returns file paths and brief text matches; use it only for repository questions.

name: read_file
description: Read a chosen allow-listed repository file after searching. Input path must be repository relative.

name: write_file
description: Modify an arbitrary working copy file. Not required for questions that only inspect code.

name: run_command
description: Run a shell command in the development environment. Not required for read-only questions.

name: send_notification
description: Send a message to an external recipient; not required for code inspection.
